name: KSHN | 200mg THC Pouch 20pk | Cinnamon
description:
Ready to turn up the heat on your routine? Meet the Cinnamon Spice KSHN Pouch, a bold and warming twist on your cannabis experience. Crafted by Michigan connoisseurs in small, high quality batches, this is not your average edible, and actually it is not an edible at all.

Think of it as your café dose with a kick. Designed for smooth, session style use, it lets you stay in control while building your buzz at your own pace. Clean, discreet, smokeless, and hands free, just tuck it, suck it, and let the warmth do its thing. No lighter, no smell, no attention. Each puck includes 20 pouches.

Forget the guessing game. Our Cool Processed™ Nanoemulsion is not magic, it is precision science. By breaking THC down into ultra absorbable particles, it moves quickly into your bloodstream and skips the slow digestive route. The result is a faster onset, more predictable effects, and a long lasting, steady ride.
